description:
ECM DEVELOPER Responsibilities 
 • Develop core FileNet components 
 • Responsible for implementation, development, configuration, support and troubleshooting FileNet and its supporting applications. 
 • Responsible for the configuration of FileNet P8, migration of documents from one system to another, using custom tools and verifying document security. 
 • Development and support of other off-the-shelf and custom developed document management solutions will be required as needed. 
 • Exposure in developing and configuring Custom Applications and Web Services in order to customize Enterprise Content Management (ECM) solutions 
 • Participate in the design, development, testing and implementation of required application changes to support the project requirements. 
 • Ensure standards and processes are being followed Experience and Skills 
 • At least 6 of experience in project life cycle activities on development and maintenance projects. 
 • Experience working in an Engineering capacity (planning, design, implementation, configuration, upgrades, migrations, troubleshooting and support) of high availability Enterprise Content Management systems (IBM FileNet Image Services, IBM FileNet P8 ECM Suite including; Content Engine, Process Engine, Application Engine, Workplace, CFS) 
 • Experience working in an engineering capacity (planning, design, implementation, configuration, troubleshooting and support) of highly available farmed J2EE Application server infrastructures. (IBM WebSphere ND) and Records Management platforms (IBM Enterprise Records) 
 • At least four years of experience implementing the following ECM technologies : (Design, Development, Implementation, Administration, Support) o IBM FileNet P8 Content Manager o IBM FileNet P8 Business Process Manager o IBM Content Navigator 
 • Ability to work as part of a team in a diverse/ multiple stakeholder environment 
 • Experience working in Banking and Financial Services domain

 Bachelor degree in Computer Science or related work experience. 


 Note : NO OPT, H1 for this position 

 Client : Infosys
